A little window into a living place.

A quiet backdrop, or a landscape your readers can explore. Match your page’s background and choose how the camera moves. Drag to orbit, scroll or pinch to zoom, and right-drag to pan. Automatic motion rests while you explore and resumes after 12 seconds.

Exploration lingers at broad points of interest and takes slow, smooth journeys between them, varying its itinerary. Speed 2 is the quieter default. The optional bridge fly-through takes about 55 seconds at this speed. Reduced-motion preferences start animation paused. Transparency lets the page color show through; the wireframe palette remains most visible against darker colors.

Paste into your page

For an interactive embed, keep pointer events enabled on the iframe and any wrapper above it. Decorative backgrounds can use interactive=0 and pointer-events:none. Keep source credits accessible when the interface is hidden: NOAA, Marin vegetation map partners, municipal records and © OpenStreetMap contributors.
